description: Save the customer-approved availability inquiry and queue staff and customer confirmations. Before sending an availability inquiry, show the actual customer the address, requested bandwidth, contact details, message and returned customer data notice. Obtain explicit approval to share them with Stealth. This requests a manual review; it does not place an order, confirm availability or promise installation timing. Never infer consent from an address search or pricing inquiry. Pass approve_submission=true only after that explicit approval. Retry the same inquiry_token after a network failure; never prepare another inquiry merely to retry.

approve_submission.description: Set to true only after the actual customer explicitly approves sharing the reviewed inquiry and contact details with Stealth.

company.description: Optional customer business or organization name.

details.description: Optional customer-provided message or details for the availability review.

email.description: Customer contact email address for the availability inquiry.

inquiry_token.description: Signed, time-limited inquiry_token returned by prepare_availability_inquiry.

name.description: Name of the customer contact requesting the availability review.

name: submit_availability_inquiry
title: Send an approved availability inquiry
